question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pervasive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses suffering as something present in all living beings.
 
• The correct adjective must describe suffering as widespread or common among all beings.
 
• "**Pervasive**" means spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people, which fits perfectly with the context.
 
• Other options ("unfamiliar", "abrasive", "corrosive") do not capture the idea of suffering being everywhere or in everyone.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The meaning and purpose of life is a/an 1. introspective__ quest that many of us indulge in at some point in life. Arthur Schopenhauer gives the purpose of life a subjective hue, rooted in 2. __compassion__, kindness and love. His philosophy asserts that acknowledging the 3. __pervasive__ nature of suffering in all living beings fosters a compassionate attitude. Cultivating moral 4. __virtues__ is a means to transcend the inherent suffering in existence. So, the recognition of shared suffering and the pursuit of moral excellence contribute to a 5. __meaningful__ life.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Unfamiliar: Means not known or recognized, which does not fit the context of suffering being everywhere.
 
• Abrasive: Means harsh or rough, which does not fit the context.
 
• Corrosive: Means capable of causing gradual destruction, which does not describe the widespread nature of suffering.
